title: XPath built by concatenation (python) — review required
description: A python XML call assembles an XPath from parts: (?:xpath|findall)s*([^)]*+. Quote-breaking input rewrites the query and reads unintended nodes. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms quoting or variable binding.
remediation: Bind values as XPath variables (xpath variables) instead of interpolating them.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled XPath matches, including trusted ones.
